evidence.q1: First content in the main column, top-left under the title line, is the STOP/STATUTORY exception for vehicle 40388 with its two actions and an 'also outside tolerance' list; the dark left rail is nav plus shift context, i.e. chrome.
evidence.q2: Only the title line 'Kingsmere Road workshop' with date, clock and two buttons sits above the exception card; nothing else spans the width.
evidence.q3: No tile row anywhere; the fleet counts (50 of 64, in service 39, spare 11, workshop 8, off road 6) live in the left nav rail as a stacked legend, not as a strip before the work.
evidence.q4: Left rail is nav and shift context (bay counts, fitters on, handover due, supervisor); the right column is the selected vehicle 40388 record and parts on order, both task material.
evidence.q5: Dominant surfaces are a bay-by-hour time grid ('The workshop's day', 6 bays 06:00-19:00) plus a defects-by-vehicle table and an inspections list, matching bays to a time grid and defects to a list.

evidence.q5: Exceptions render as a ranked queue, open defects as a sortable table by vehicle, the workshop's day as a five-bay time grid — each unit gets its matching form.
